noised-k100: the clean latent noised to level 100, decoded so it can be seen (retrained model)

clean-latent-target: the clean latent the loss compares the guess with (retrained model)
time-features-k100: the 64 time features of level 100: 32 sines then 32 cosines
noised-k150: the clean latent noised to level 150, decoded so it can be seen (retrained model)
